description: Sidebar ProjectCtx gains refs <promoted>/<declared> (with !<k> for check problems, - before a resolve, ? for an invalid file); the /projectctx modal gets a References tab (condition, anchor, promotion status and reason per declaration, plus the problems of keryx skills references check); /projectctx refs opens it; a polling feed repaints the sidebar and the open tab on a new resolve; TUI-states.md is authoritative and every row has a render test.

behavior_changes.description: The References tab is always present in /projectctx, including a project with no references file, where it shows one line naming `keryx skills references suggest` (TUI-states R0). Status and Last resolve tab text and the sidebar line are unchanged without a references file.
alternatives: Hide the tab until a references file exists (then /projectctx refs would have nothing to open)

behavior_changes.description: The usage line of an invalid /projectctx argument now reads [warn|block|refs]; the existing parse test was updated for it.
The ProjectCtx line is now shown when the project has a references file even with no rules and no recorded resolve (warn · 0 rules · refs -/<n>).

assumptions: A declared reference is told apart from a cited contract by the resolver entry's condition field; only declared entries count towards <promoted>.
A references file with zero declarations is shown as refs -/0 (or 0/0), not hidden, so undeclared-citation problems can surface.
A resolve recorded by a worker outside the TUI is picked up by polling the status every 5 seconds (unref'd interval, same pattern as the decisions and approvals sidebars).
